settingsSwipeDeleteTips: Enable swipe to delete list item.
settingsDeviceDiscoveryTips: Enable device broadcast receiver, allowing other devices on the same LAN to discover this device.
settingsPipModeTips: Display a floating window when the app moves to the background during traffic recording.
settingsPreferTableModeTips: In requests and responses, prefer to display data in table mode, such as parameters, headers, etc.
settingsApplicationBackgroundModeTips: The application will not automatically exit when the main window is closed, you can choose to exit the application from the tray.
settingsApplicationBackgroundModeMessage: Reqable is about to enter the background. You can restore the window or exit the application from the tray. To disable this mode, please go to Settings.
settingsLayoutAxisFollowGlobalTips: When switching between horizontal and vertical layout, the request and response layout orientation is applied instead of the overall layout.
settingsZenModeTips: When Zen mode is turned on, non-essential UI elements such as the top action bar will be hidden, allowing you to focus on the API content.
settingsPreferCreateHttpTips: When clicking the `+` button on the tab bar to create a new API, directly create an HTTP request instead of expanding the option menu. After enabling this option, the menu will be available via right-click.
settingsVersionUpdateTipStrategyDescript: Configure the notification policy for when a new version is detected.
settingsPrivacyTips: Help improve Reqable by automatically sending usage data. Usage data is collected anonymously and cannot be used to identify you.
settingsCaptureAutoTips: Reqable will automatically enter the recording state after it is started. There is no need to manually click the `Start` button.
settingsSystemProxyAutoTips: The system network proxy will be automatically overridden when the capture is started, if you prefer manual control, turn this option off.
settingsRemoteControlTips: Allow remote devices to synchronously control the local recording state.
settingsNetbareTips: Print traffic logs to file, which may contain sensitive data, please pay attention to review before providing it to developers.
settingsDangerInfo: These operations are irreversible, please be certain.
settingsClearCacheInfo: Delete all stored temporary data such as history, logs, but excluding the user's app data like API collections.
settingsClearCacheDialogMessage: Are you sure to delete all temporary data? Note that the data cannot be recovered after clearing!
settingsResetAppInfo: Delete all user data and restore the app. After the reset is complete, the app will automatically restart.
settingsResetAppDialogMessage: Are you sure you want to delete all user data and reset the app? Note that data cannot be recovered after reset!
settingsDangerLastAlertMessage: You are performing a high-risk operation, the last confirmation!
